task.title: To refresh clauses in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the Dropdown button () and select Refresh Clauses.

info.p: If the template contains clauses with no changes, you will see a message stating "No clauses are found for refresh".
If the template contains clauses with changes, you will receive a message showing which clauses must be refreshed.

step.cmd: Click Refresh to update all of the clauses that are within your main template. A confirmation message is displayed.

ul.li: When you Refresh Clauses, the default space inside a clause between two lines is removed. If you need additional space between the two lines, you must add space manually.
When you Refresh Clauses, one line of space is added after the clause.
